pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. Two groups of equally sized green solid circles, FIVE on LEFT, THREE on right. One red downward arrow above LEFT group identifies MORE. Clearly separated groups, flat solid fills dark outlines, no people, numbers, letters or mathematical signs. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.

alt.ca: Una fletxa assenyala el grup que té més cercles verds que l’altre.
alt.es: Una flecha señala el grupo que tiene más círculos verdes que el otro.
